# SaaS Landing Page Plan

## 目标
Build a responsive SaaS landing page that clearly presents the product value proposition, pricing plans, and FAQ content, so visitors can quickly understand the offering and convert through prominent calls to action. Success looks like a clean, componentized implementation that compiles successfully, renders all required sections, and keeps each file small and focused.

## 技术约束
- React with TypeScript
- Component-based frontend only; no backend required
- Use `output/` prefix for all generated files
- Each step must produce exactly one file
- Keep each file under roughly 80 lines of generated code
- Pricing and FAQ must be implemented as separate reusable sections
- Page should be responsive using simple CSS-in-JS or inline style objects without external dependencies
- All imports must use relative paths
- Final page entry should compose all sections into one page

## 假设
- A React + TypeScript build environment already exists
- The app entry can render a default exported page component from `output/app/LandingPage.tsx`
- No design system or CSS framework is available
- Static content is acceptable for hero, pricing, and FAQ sections
- CTA buttons do not need live navigation and may use placeholder links
- Accessibility should be addressed with semantic HTML where practical

---

## 步骤

### step: types-content
- title: Define landing page content types
- role: types
- file: output/types/content.ts
- depends: []
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Create and export the following interfaces:
    - `export interface HeroContent { headline: string; subheadline: string; primaryCtaLabel: string; secondaryCtaLabel: string }`
    - `export interface PricingPlan { name: string; priceMonthly: string; description: string; features: string[]; highlighted: boolean; ctaLabel: string }`
    - `export interface FaqItem { question: string; answer: string }`
    - `export interface LandingPageContent { hero: HeroContent; pricing: PricingPlan[]; faq: FaqItem[] }`
    No imports required.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [HeroContent, PricingPlan, FaqItem, LandingPageContent]
    compile: true

### step: data-content
- title: Add static landing page content
- role: implementer
- file: output/data/content.ts
- depends: [types-content]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `LandingPageContent` from `../types/content`
    Define and export:
    - `export const landingPageContent: LandingPageContent`
    Populate `landingPageContent.hero`, `landingPageContent.pricing`, and `landingPageContent.faq` with static SaaS marketing copy.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [landingPageContent]
    compile: true

### step: styles-theme
- title: Define shared style helpers
- role: implementer
- file: output/styles/theme.ts
- depends: []
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `CSSProperties` from `react`
    Define and export:
    - `export const colors: { background: string; surface: string; text: string; muted: string; primary: string; border: string }`
    - `export const layout: { page: CSSProperties; section: CSSProperties; container: CSSProperties; grid: CSSProperties }`
    - `export function cardStyle(highlighted?: boolean): CSSProperties`
    Return plain style objects only.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [colors, layout, cardStyle]
    compile: true

### step: component-hero
- title: Implement hero section component
- role: implementer
- file: output/components/HeroSection.tsx
- depends: [types-content, styles-theme]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `React` from `react`
    - `HeroContent` from `../types/content`
    - `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
    Define and export:
    - `export interface HeroSectionProps { content: HeroContent }`
    - `export function HeroSection(props: HeroSectionProps): JSX.Element`
    Render a semantic `section` with headline, subheadline, and two CTA links/buttons using inline styles.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [HeroSectionProps, HeroSection]
    compile: true

### step: component-pricing
- title: Implement pricing section component
- role: implementer
- file: output/components/PricingSection.tsx
- depends: [types-content, styles-theme]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `React` from `react`
    - `PricingPlan` from `../types/content`
    - `colors`, `layout`, `cardStyle` from `../styles/theme`
    Define and export:
    - `export interface PricingSectionProps { plans: PricingPlan[] }`
    - `export function PricingSection(props: PricingSectionProps): JSX.Element`
    Render a `section` containing a heading and a responsive list of plan cards. For each plan, render name, price, description, feature list, and CTA control.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [PricingSectionProps, PricingSection]
    compile: true

### step: component-faq
- title: Implement FAQ section component
- role: implementer
- file: output/components/FaqSection.tsx
- depends: [types-content, styles-theme]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `React` from `react`
    - `FaqItem` from `../types/content`
    - `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
    Define and export:
    - `export interface FaqSectionProps { items: FaqItem[] }`
    - `export function FaqSection(props: FaqSectionProps): JSX.Element`
    Render a `section` with a heading and a list of FAQ items using semantic elements such as `dl`, `dt`, and `dd`.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [FaqSectionProps, FaqSection]
    compile: true

### step: component-header
- title: Implement simple page header
- role: implementer
- file: output/components/PageHeader.tsx
- depends: [styles-theme]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `React` from `react`
    - `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
    Define and export:
    - `export interface PageHeaderProps { productName: string; navItems: { label: string; href: string }[] }`
    - `export function PageHeader(props: PageHeaderProps): JSX.Element`
    Render a top header with brand name and simple navigation links to `#pricing` and `#faq`.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [PageHeaderProps, PageHeader]
    compile: true

### step: component-footer
- title: Implement simple page footer
- role: implementer
- file: output/components/PageFooter.tsx
- depends: [styles-theme]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `React` from `react`
    - `colors`, `layout` from `../styles/theme`
    Define and export:
    - `export function PageFooter(): JSX.Element`
    Render a footer with short copyright text and one support link.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [PageFooter]
    compile: true

### step: app-landing-page
- title: Compose the full landing page
- role: integrator
- file: output/app/LandingPage.tsx
- depends: [data-content, component-hero, component-pricing, component-faq, component-header, component-footer, styles-theme]
- checkpoint: false
- task: |
    Import:
    - `React` from `react`
    - `landingPageContent` from `../data/content`
    - `layout` from `../styles/theme`
    - `PageHeader` from `../components/PageHeader`
    - `HeroSection` from `../components/HeroSection`
    - `PricingSection` from `../components/PricingSection`
    - `FaqSection` from `../components/FaqSection`
    - `PageFooter` from `../components/PageFooter`
    Define and export:
    - `export default function LandingPage(): JSX.Element`
    Compose the page in order: header, hero, pricing, FAQ, footer. Pass static nav items with `#pricing` and `#faq`. Wrap content in a root element using shared page styles.
  acceptance: |
    exports: [default]
    compile: true

### step: checkpoint-review
- title: Review composition and export coverage
- role: checkpoint
- file: output/checkpoints/landing-page-review.md
- depends: [app-landing-page]
- checkpoint: true
- task: |
    Create a markdown checklist that verifies:
    - all section components are exported
    - all imports in `output/app/LandingPage.tsx` are relative and resolvable
    - hero, pricing, and FAQ sections are present
    - pricing links target the pricing section and FAQ nav targets the FAQ section
    - all files compile under TypeScript React settings
    Export no symbols.
  acceptance: |
    exports: []
    compile: false
